goal: Build a polished static browser notes app for personal use, with no backend or external service dependency. Users can create a note with a required nonblank title and optional body, edit it, delete it after confirmation, and search titles and bodies case-insensitively. Persist notes in localStorage across reloads. Show useful empty, validation, and storage-error states. Render user text safely as text. Support keyboard and pointer/touch use on desktop and mobile. Deliver a README with an exact local serving command and meaningful automated tests covering CRUD, search, persistence, and invalid storage. The app must run from a clean copy with only documented dependencies.

requirements.behavior: Create two distinct notes; both visible with exact entered title/body; whitespace-only title rejected without mutation.
Edit one note, preserve the other, reload, and verify edited content and identities remain correct.
Cancel deletion leaves state unchanged; confirm deletion removes only the chosen note and persists after reload.
Search finds title/body matches regardless of case; no-match state clear; clearing search restores all remaining notes.
New empty store has a useful empty state; corrupt stored JSON and denied/quota-exceeded writes produce a visible recoverable error without crashing or reporting a false save.
HTML-looking user input remains text and executes no script or event handler after save/reload.
Keyboard and pointer can complete CRUD/search; labels and focus usable; desktop/mobile controls not clipped.
Documented install/serve/test commands work in a clean copy; tests execute assertions, and an intentionally broken persistence fixture is detected.
